domain: finite-dimensional vector spaces over GF(2); indexed subspace occurrences; two geometric classes U and W; multiplicities a,b >= 1

fixed_order_formula.mixed_both_cut_predicate: there exists an internal cut i with 0<u_i<a and 0<w_i<b, where u_i,w_i are prefix occurrence counts

symbolic_proof_plan.cut_type_table: Every internal side span is U, W, or U+W. Intersections have dimensions p, q, r, or s=p+q-r. A mixed|mixed cut is exactly the s case.
symbolic_proof_plan.mixed_both_characterization: A cut is mixed on both sides iff 0<u_i<a and 0<w_i<b. If such a cut exists, width(order)=s because s>=p,q,r.
symbolic_proof_plan.lower_bound_U: If a>=2, the first and last U-occurrence positions determine an internal cut with a U-occurrence on each side. Hence both side spans contain U, their intersection contains U, and layout width is at least p.
symbolic_proof_plan.lower_bound_W: If b>=2, symmetrically every layout has width at least q.
symbolic_proof_plan.single_single_lower_upper: If a=b=1, the unique internal cut is U | W and has width r.
symbolic_proof_plan.grouped_upper_bound: Use U^a W^b or W^b U^a. There is no mixed|mixed cut; internal U-block cuts have width p, the class boundary has width r, and internal W-block cuts have width q. Therefore the grouped maximum equals the pathwidth formula.
symbolic_proof_plan.grouped_order_characterization: When a,b>=2, no mixed|mixed cut occurs iff the class pattern is grouped as U^a W^b or W^b U^a.
symbolic_proof_plan.indexed_occurrence_rule: Multiplicity is over distinct input occurrence identities even when geometric subspaces are equal.

proof_requirements: symbolic derivation independent of exhaustive controls
exact fixed-order formula verified for every replayed class-pattern order
exhaustive all-subspace-pair controls for ambient dimensions 0..4
all class-pattern layouts replayed; indexed multiplicity counted separately
tamper/falsification suite must bind symbolic proof fields
literature novelty audit before NEW_RESULT promotion
